notes.title: Update 1.3.830
notes.content:
Hello ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the first Goscurry Steam update.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added optional [b]unlocked cities randomization[/b].
On the PLAY panel you have a new option which, if checked, will randomize the order of all the cities you unlocked. The ones that are still locked will keep their order, so this is just a visual candy, and not a way to unlock cities more easily.
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed [b]Ram[/b] and [b]Diver[/b] achievements calculating values per mode instead than overall. If you should've got one of these achievements already, starting Goscurry after this update will immediately grant it.
[/list]

notes.title: Update coming within the week
notes.content:
An update will come later this week, with a [b]bugfix for the Ram and Diver achievements[/b], which are currently taking into account falls/crashes for individual modes instead than for all of them together. I deeply apologize for this and am working on it.

Other than that, there will be [b]an option to randomize the cities order[/b] (only for the ones you unlocked), as suggested by @Hobbes.

PUKE mode is done but won't be in this update, since I want to take more time on it and make it more flashy.

Cheers!

tags.bug: - bugfix for the Ram and Diver achievements
